meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建或编辑自定义视频组合，用于多场景、品牌片、蒙太奇等
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要进行专业视频创作而无现成模板可用
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need professional video creation with no pre-built template

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能创建或编辑视频组合，包括多场景片段、品牌短片、蒙太奇、静态循环、标题卡、素材混剪等。自动读取项目状态并执行计划、构建场景。
howto.when: 当没有专门工作流可用，或 BRIEF.md 的 flow 设为 companion 时触发。还用于较长或多场景作品。

say.text: 根据这个简章，生成一个30秒的品牌宣传片。
say.note: Claude 将读取 BRIEF.md 并创建视频。

say.text: 编辑我现有的视频项目，添加一个结尾场景。
say.note: Claude 将定位项目并执行修改。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can author or edit HyperFrames compositions: multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static loops, title cards, footage remixes. It reads project state and executes plan/build stages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Also for longer/multi-scene works.

say_en.text: Generate a 30-second brand reel from this brief.
say_en.note: Claude reads BRIEF.md and creates the video.

say_en.text: Edit my existing project and append a closing scene.
say_en.note: Claude locates project and applies edit.
